<includeonly><div style="position: relative; width: 80px;">{{{icon}}}<div style="position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; padding: 0; pointer-events: none;">[[File:{{{sparkle}}}|{{{sparkle_size}}}|link=]]</div></div></includeonly><noinclude>
== Template:SparkleIcon ==

Displays a framed item icon with an optional sparkle overlay for quality tiers. The sparkle draws above the icon, has no file link, and lets clicks reach the icon below.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Default !! Description
|-
| '''icon''' || Yes || || The framed item icon from <nowiki>{{Icon|filename.png|kind=item|size=80}}</nowiki>
|-
| '''sparkle''' || Yes || || Sparkle overlay image filename (Blue_Sparkle.gif, Purple_Sparkle.gif, or blank.png)
|-
| '''sparkle_size''' || Yes || || Size of the sparkle overlay (e.g., 80px)
|}

=== Examples ===

'''Normal item (no sparkle - use blank.png):'''
<pre>
{{SparkleIcon
|icon={{Icon|Copper_Sword.png|kind=item|size=80}}
|sparkle=blank.png
|sparkle_size=0px
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{SparkleIcon
|icon={{Icon|Copper_Sword.png|kind=item|size=80}}
|sparkle=blank.png
|sparkle_size=0px
}}

----

'''Blessed item (blue sparkle):'''
<pre>
{{SparkleIcon
|icon={{Icon|Copper_Sword.png|kind=item|size=80}}
|sparkle=Blue_Sparkle.gif
|sparkle_size=80px
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{SparkleIcon
|icon={{Icon|Copper_Sword.png|kind=item|size=80}}
|sparkle=Blue_Sparkle.gif
|sparkle_size=80px
}}

----

'''Godly item (purple sparkle):'''
<pre>
{{SparkleIcon
|icon={{Icon|Copper_Sword.png|kind=item|size=80}}
|sparkle=Purple_Sparkle.gif
|sparkle_size=80px
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{SparkleIcon
|icon={{Icon|Copper_Sword.png|kind=item|size=80}}
|sparkle=Purple_Sparkle.gif
|sparkle_size=80px
}}
